about_short_description.short_description: Air Space Intelligence develops aerospace & defense software with AI-powered decision-support platform for complex operational planning.

product.name: Prescience Platform
product.description: An AI-powered operational planning platform that fuses data, models complex geospatial and temporal environments, predicts future conditions, evaluates courses of action, supports collaboration, and enables operational replay.

product.name: NITMRE-Geo
product.description: An AI-enabled geospatial application for U.S. Air Force mobility operations that provides global mission visibility, workflow coordination, monitoring, optimization, and course-of-action support.

product.name: Airline Operations Solutions
product.description: Decision-support software for airline network and operations teams that predicts disruptions, models downstream effects, and supports coordinated responses across the air transportation network.

product.name: Air Traffic Management Solutions
product.description: Predictive and simulation-based software for air traffic and flow managers that improves visibility into future demand, capacity constraints, and traffic-management outcomes.

product.name: Global Logistics Solutions
product.description: Operational planning software for multimodal logistics that provides visibility, forecasting, coordination, and optimization across air, freight, rail, and maritime transportation networks.

product.name: Defense Solutions
product.description: AI-enabled operational planning and command-and-control software for defense organizations that models future battlefield conditions and supports mission coordination across domains.
